name: Whenua Whānui Fund
summary: Co-funding for collectives such as iwi, hapū, marae, community and landcare groups in the Kaipara Moana catchment to fence waterways, plant natives and regenerate native forest on erodible land, tied to a sediment reduction plan.
reporting: A Field Advisor visits the site after completion to confirm the work meets agreed standards before the final invoice.

eligibility.rule: Project is in the Kaipara Moana catchment
Sediment Reduction Plan developed for the project
Work not started before the contract is signed
Project not required under a resource consent
Planting area of at least 0.25 ha

applicant_types.quote: open to collectives such as iwi/hapū, marae, community groups, landcare groups, catchment groups, kaitiaki groups, schools

geography.quote: Projects must be based in the Kaipara Moana catchment.

access.quote: Submit your interest in applying for KMR funding.

eligibility.quote: Projects must be based in the Kaipara Moana catchment.
To unlock KMR funding, a Sediment Reduction Plan must be developed.
We cannot fund projects required under resource consent, nor projects to landscape or beautify a site.
KMR requires a minimum planting area of 0.25ha [2500 square metres] to co-fund planting

co_finance_required.quote: We can contribute up to 70% of the estimated project costs for agreed activities.

co_finance.quote: We can contribute up to 70% of the estimated project costs for agreed activities.

after_award.quote: After the project is completed, a KMR Field Advisor will visit your site to confirm that work is completed to the agreed standards.

reporting.quote: After the project is completed, a KMR Field Advisor will visit your site to confirm that work is completed to the agreed standards.

effort.quote: Submit your interest in applying for KMR funding.
A Kaipara Moana Remediation Field Advisor (Field Advisor) will contact you to schedule a site visit.
The Field Advisor will submit your application to a KMR representative for approval.

steps: Site visit and sediment reduction plan with a Field Advisor
